notes: A Lítačka 24-hour ticket costs 120 CZK (tram, metro, funicular). The centre is walkable. The AE bus to the airport costs 100 CZK. Use Bolt or Uber instead of taxis.
Christmas markets run in December (Old Town Square, 1 December to 6 January). Winter temperatures range from -3 to 3°C, with snow. The castle and bridge are quiet, and Kutná Hora is peaceful.
Beer costs 50-70 CZK (cheaper than water), goulash 200-250, svíčková 250, croissant and coffee 100. Tip 10%. A cover charge is sometimes added to the bill.
Beware of exchange offices advertising 0% commission (bad rate). At ATMs, choose your own bank's rate. If you are offered payment in EUR, the rate is poor. Cards are accepted everywhere.
Castle main circuit 450 CZK. Josefov is closed on Saturdays. Book Sedlec Ossuary tickets online, no photography. Buy your Krumlov bus ticket from RegioJet days in advance.
Trdelník is not Czech (Hungarian/Slovak) but it is tasty. Truly Czech dishes: svíčková, vepřo knedlo zelo, smažený sýr (fried cheese), koláče (sweet pastries).

stops.name: Charles Bridge
stops.tips: 14th-century bridge with 30 statues. It is empty before 8 am. Touch the statue of St John of Nepomuk.

stops.name: Old Town Square
stops.tips: Týn Church and the Jan Hus Monument. The Astronomical Clock performs every hour from 09:00 to 23:00 (the 12 apostles).

stops.name: Old Town Hall Tower
stops.tips: Tower with a lift. Panoramic views over the square, no queue in the morning.

stops.name: Jewish Quarter Josefov
stops.tips: Old-New Synagogue, Old Jewish Cemetery (12,000 gravestones) and Pinkas Synagogue. Closed on Saturdays.

stops.name: Lokál Dlouhá
stops.tips: Beer from the best Pilsner Urquell tank, plus svíčková (beef in cream sauce) and goulash in a classic Czech canteen.

backups.name: Klementinum
backups.tips: Baroque library and astronomical tower. Swap for Josefov.

stops.name: Prague Castle
stops.tips: The world's largest castle complex. See St Vitus Cathedral (Mucha stained glass), the Old Royal Palace and Golden Lane (Kafka's house at No. 22). Arrive at the 09:00 opening. Tickets are timed in summer, and there is a security check at the gate.

stops.name: Malá Strana Walk
stops.tips: Look for the house signs on Nerudova Street, and the dome of the Baroque Church of St Nicholas.

stops.name: U Modré Kachničky
stops.tips: The Blue Duck: goose and duck are Bohemian classics, in Malá Strana.

stops.name: Kampa Island & Museum
stops.tips: River island park with David Černý's babies and the Kampa Museum (Kupka), 350 CZK.

stops.name: Petřín Hill Funicular & Tower
stops.tips: Winter sunset is at 16:30. See the lit-up city from the tower.

backups.name: Café Savoy
backups.tips: 1893 café with an ornate ceiling, in Malá Strana.

backups.name: Strahov Monastery Library
backups.tips: Baroque library and beer. Swap for Petřín.

stops.name: Vyšehrad
stops.tips: Hilltop fort that predates Prague Castle. See Slavín Cemetery (Dvořák, Mucha), the Rotunda and river views. Free.

stops.name: Vinohradský Parlament
stops.tips: Czech restaurant in Vinohrady. Try vepřo knedlo zelo (pork, dumplings and cabbage).

stops.name: Riegrovy Sady
stops.tips: Winter park walk with views of the castle.

stops.name: Žižkov Television Tower
stops.tips: Černý's climbing babies and a 93 m observation deck.

stops.name: U Slovanské Lípy
stops.tips: Old Žižkov pub with 10+ beer tanks and pork knuckle.

backups.name: Kavárna Slavia
backups.tips: Riverside café from 1884, opposite the National Theatre.

backups.name: National Museum
backups.tips: At the top of Wenceslas Square, with a dome. Swap for Žižkov.

stops.name: Sedlec Ossuary
stops.tips: 1 hour by train (Hlavní). Chandelier and coat of arms made from 40,000 skeletons (the Bone Church). Book tickets online. No photography.

stops.name: St. Barbara's Cathedral
stops.tips: Gothic cathedral of the silver miners. UNESCO-listed, with a terrace at the Jesuit College.

stops.name: Kutná Hora Historic Centre
stops.tips: Medieval streets, the Stone Fountain and the Italian Court (the mint).

stops.name: Dačický Kutná Hora
stops.tips: Medieval beer hall with local beer and duck.

stops.name: Czech Museum of Silver Hrádek
stops.tips: Descend into a medieval silver mine (helmet and apron provided). Guided tour, then the train back.

backups.name: Karlštejn Castle
backups.tips: Charles IV's Gothic castle, 40 minutes by train. Swap for Kutná Hora (closed on Mondays).

backups.name: Pivnice Dačický Bahçe
backups.tips: The garden of the same venue. Sausages.

stops.name: Letná Park Metronome
stops.tips: Metronome on the site of the former Stalin statue. Views of the bridges, and a beer garden in summer.

stops.name: National Technical Museum
stops.tips: Aeroplanes, trains and vintage cars, in Letná.

stops.name: Holešovice Market Hall
stops.tips: Pražská tržnice: Vietnamese pho and Czech food stalls.

stops.name: DOX Centre for Contemporary Art
stops.tips: Contemporary art and a rooftop airship, in Holešovice.

stops.name: Stromovka Park
stops.tips: Former royal hunting park with ponds and a planetarium.

backups.name: Prague Zoo
backups.tips: One of Europe's best zoos (Troja). Swap for DOX and Stromovka.

stops.name: Český Krumlov Castle
stops.tips: RegioJet bus, 3 hours (Florenc, about 200 CZK, leave at 07:00). A UNESCO town in a bend of the Vltava with the country's 2nd-largest castle. Tower 180 CZK, Baroque theatre tour.

stops.name: Castle Garden Český Krumlov
stops.tips: Cascading garden and a revolving auditorium theatre.

stops.name: Krčma v Šatlavské
stops.tips: Medieval dungeon tavern serving meat cooked over an open fire.

stops.name: Český Krumlov Old Town
stops.tips: Latrán and the main square, plus the Egon Schiele Art Centrum (200 CZK).

stops.name: Vltava Rafting Krumlov
stops.tips: In winter, walk along the river and enjoy the view of the Cloak Bridge.

backups.name: Hluboká Castle
backups.tips: White castle resembling Windsor. An alternative on the way to Krumlov.

stops.name: Wenceslas Square
stops.tips: Square of the 1989 Velvet Revolution. The National Museum is at the top, and the upside-down horse is in the Lucerna arcade.

stops.name: Havelské Tržiště
stops.tips: Market in the Old Town for souvenirs and fruit. Go to Moser for Bohemian crystal.

stops.name: Café Louvre
stops.tips: 1902 café (Kafka, Einstein). Have a farewell breakfast and play billiards.

stops.name: Hlavní Nádraží Airport Bus
stops.tips: AE bus takes 35 minutes, or take the metro plus bus 119. Farewell.

backups.name: Trdelník Stand Old Town
backups.tips: Trdelník (sweet rolled pastry) with ice cream. Touristy but tasty. Farewell treat.

backups.name: Mucha Museum
backups.tips: Art nouveau posters. Swap for the market.
